years_since_diagnosis.evidence: diagnosed with Crohn's eight years ago

severity.evidence: Failed mesalamine, multiple prednisone courses, failed azathioprine, failed methotrexate, now on Remicade which is failing — treatment-refractory course suggests moderate-to-severe disease

treatments.evidence: Started on mesalamine for Crohn's. Minimal improvement.

treatments.reason_stopped: Doctor worried about bone density; each taper harder
treatments.evidence: Added prednisone for bad flares. Used it four times now. Each time harder to taper. Doctor worried about bone density.
Tried azathioprine, elevated liver enzymes. Stopped.

treatments.reason_stopped: Made him feel impaired ('drunk all the time'); unsafe for construction work
treatments.evidence: Methotrexate next, made me feel drunk all the time. Couldn't work safely.

Finally went on Remicade three years ago. Infusions every eight weeks... Worked well for two years then effectiveness dropped. Increased frequency to every six weeks. Helped temporarily. Now failing again.

encounters.evidence: Finally saw doctor. Did all the tests. Colonoscopy, endoscopy, found inflammation in colon.
Finally went on Remicade three years ago... Doctor wants to switch to Humira. Will discuss Humira at next appointment.

status.evidence: Finally went on Remicade three years ago. Infusions every eight weeks.
